description: Setup: Movies library, first shelf selected. Read-only browsing; no playback or account writes.

steps.name: 01-library-rails
steps.review: No Recently Watched row or single-title recommendation row, including cast/director, genre and top-movie recommendations. Recently Added, Continue Watching and explicit collections remain, even if a collection has only one title.

steps.name: 02-recently-added-depth
steps.review: Setup on Recently Added with >12 eligible items: navigate beyond card 12. Repeat for Home and TV. A season and its contained episodes must not both appear; another season without a container may appear. Maximum 48, fewer when Plex supplies fewer eligible items.
